name: en_answered_elsewhere
description: One answer settles two questions: the clarification of 'too many attempts' gives the number, so the missing-boundary question for the same requirement must not be asked again.
requirements:
REQ-1: After too many failed login attempts, the account is locked.
REQ-2: The user can unlock the account by email.

issues.note: what the user receives to unlock

rule.ambiguous_wording.REQ-1.value: The account is locked after 5 failed attempts within 15 minutes.

rule.missing_expected_result.REQ-2.value: An email with a one-time unlock link is sent to the registered address.

questions.question: How long does the account stay locked?
